title: Renewal Payment Retry and Hold Schedule, Northgate+ Memberships
content:
Billing schedule of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** for a declined renewal fee: how many automatic retries run, how far apart, how long the payment hold lasts before an unpaid membership lapses, and whether paid benefits continue meanwhile.

| Tier | Automatic retries after a declined renewal fee | Calendar days between the decline and each retry | Payment hold grace period (calendar days after the first declined renewal fee) | Paid benefits apply on payment hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate+ Assist | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Northgate+ Student | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Northgate+ Annual | 3 | 3 | 14 | no |
| Northgate+ Business | 3 | 3 | 14 | no |

**Definitions**

- *Automatic retries*: the number of automatic retries after a declined renewal fee.
- *Retry interval*: the calendar days between the decline and each automatic retry.
- *Grace period*: the calendar days after the first declined renewal fee after which an unpaid membership lapses to canceled.
- *Paid benefits on payment hold*: whether paid benefits apply while the membership is on payment hold; on every tier they do not.

**Reading the schedule**

- The monthly-billed paid tiers carry a 10-day grace period; Northgate+ Annual and Northgate+ Business carry 14 days.
- Northgate Rewards charges no fee, so it carries no retries and no grace period.
